r1c1.name: Entrance Hall
r1c1.description: A cluttered Victorian entrance hall inspired by classic platformer rooms, with patterned tiled floor, narrow staircase to the left, tall windows, and scattered furniture. Photorealistic, modern color grading, cinematic lighting, warm tungsten highlights, soft film grain, high detail.

variants.day: Photorealistic modern interpretation of a Victorian entrance hall: patterned tiled floor, narrow staircase, tall windows with daylight, scattered vintage furniture, subtle dust motes, warm sunlight — ultra-detailed, 4k, cinematic lighting
variants.night: Photorealistic night version of the entrance hall: cool moonlight through windows, interior lamps casting warm pools, deeper shadows, reflective floor — ultra-detailed, 4k
variants.snow: Entrance hall with cold bluish ambient light and snowfall visible through the windows; crisp, frosty highlights, photorealistic, 4k
